evidence.section: 3 Mechanical properties of designed Al-TMs HEAs
evidence.quote: These designed alloy ingots with about 100 g were fabricated via a vacuum arc-melting furnace. To prevent oxidation, the vacuum of the furnace was controlled below 6×10-3 Pa, and the chamber was filled by a purity of 99.99% argon. To guarantee the composition homogeneity, these alloys ingots were remelted at least four times.

evidence.section: 3 Mechanical properties of designed Al-TMs HEAs
evidence.quote: In these alloys, which contain more than five elements in nearly equi-atomic ratios, the entropy of mixing (ΔSmix) is significantly improved compared to traditional solid solution alloys. Then, according to the equation of ΔGmix=ΔHmix-ΔSmix [24], the ΔGmix (the Gibbs free energy of mixing) is decreased, which is beneficial to improve the stability of solid solution.

evidence.section: 3 Mechanical properties of designed Al-TMs HEAs

evidence.section: 4 Conclusions
evidence.quote: By partly substituting Ta for Mo, the strength of [Al-Ti3V3Nb4Mo3Ta]Al at room temperature and high temperature drastically decreases, suggesting that Ta element deteriorates the strength and plasticity of Al-TMs alloys.
